title: 高層建築液壓爬模施工~Hydraulic climbing-form construction
focus: 把整套模板與平台錨固在剛澆好的牆上逐層自爬：錨點強度、油壓爬升、樓層循環與風速管制~Self-climbing a complete form and platform set storey by storey on freshly cast walls: anchor strength, hydraulic lifting, floor cycles and wind control
summary: 液壓自動爬模與滑模不同：每層混凝土澆置後先硬化，再由油壓缸把模板與多層工作平台沿爬升軌道推到上一層，荷載經由預埋錨錐傳入早齡牆體。本課以哈里發塔的 226 組自爬單元與 3 天樓層循環、樂天世界塔的核心筒與巨柱爬模為例，說明循環時程、錨點荷載路徑、油壓機構、模板側壓、平台荷重、爬升停檢點、早齡強度驗收、同步監測、錨孔處理與拆除交接。~Hydraulic automatic climbing forms differ from slipforms: each lift of concrete hardens first, then hydraulic cylinders push the forms and multi-level working platforms along climbing rails to the next storey, with loads passing through cast-in anchor cones into young walls. Using the 226 self-climbing units and three-day floor cycle at Burj Khalifa and the core and megacolumn climbing forms at Lotte World Tower, the course covers cycle time, the anchor load path, hydraulics, form pressure, platform loads, climbing hold points, early-strength acceptance, synchronisation monitoring, anchor-hole treatment and dismantling handover.

units.anchor: 樓層循環時程~Floor cycle time
units.title: 自動爬模的工序與樓層循環~Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle
units.mechanism: 自動爬模把核心筒施工拆成重複的樓層循環：綁紮鋼筋與安裝埋件、合模、澆置、等待混凝土達到可拆模與可承載錨點的強度、拆模後以油壓缸把模板與平台爬升一層、清理並調整模板，再進入下一循環。與滑模相比，它容許每層停下來檢查鋼筋與埋件，牆厚變化與退縮也較容易處理，但速度受限於循環中最慢的工序。哈里發塔以 180 次澆置、每次 3.70 m 高完成核心筒與翼牆，標準循環為每層 3 天。~Automatic climbing breaks core construction into repeated floor cycles: fixing rebar and embeds, closing the forms, pouring, waiting for the concrete to reach the strength needed to strike and to carry the anchors, climbing forms and platforms one storey with hydraulic cylinders after striking, then cleaning and adjusting the forms before the next cycle. Compared with slipforming it allows a stop at every level to inspect rebar and embeds and handles changes in wall thickness and setbacks more easily, but its speed is limited by the slowest activity in the cycle. Burj Khalifa completed its core and wing walls in 180 pours of 3.70 m each on a standard three-day floor cycle.
units.model: 循環時間 T = 鋼筋埋件 24 h + 合模 8 h + 澆置 8 h + 等強度 24 h + 拆模爬升清理 8 h = 72 h（3 天）。180 次澆置共 540 天；若以較高的混凝土溫度把等強度時間縮為 16 h，T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 天，總計 480 天，節省約 60 天。數值為教學假設。~Cycle time T = rebar and embeds 24 h + closing forms 8 h + pouring 8 h + strength wait 24 h + strike, climb and clean 8 h = 72 h (three days). 180 pours take 540 days; cutting the strength wait to 16 h with warmer concrete gives T = 64 h ≈ 2.67 days and 480 days in total, saving about 60 days. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以線性排程或網圖模擬每一樓層循環，找出關鍵工序並記錄實際各工序時間；每週比較計畫與實際循環，若某工序持續超時，檢討人力、塔吊時段或混凝土配比，而不是壓縮等強度時間。~Simulate each floor cycle with a linear schedule or network, identify the critical activity and record actual durations; compare planned and actual cycles weekly and, if one activity keeps overrunning, review labour, crane time or the mix rather than squeezing the strength wait.
units.failure: 為追趕進度在混凝土強度不足時就拆模爬升，錨點周圍混凝土局部破壞，平台下沉或傾斜；或在循環中臨時插入未規劃的牆厚變化，模板需現場改裝而打亂後續數層的節奏。~Climbing before the concrete is strong enough to catch up on programme can crush concrete around the anchors and let the platform sink or tilt; inserting an unplanned change in wall thickness mid-cycle forces site modifications to the forms and disrupts the rhythm of several following storeys.
units.misconception: 爬模的循環速度主要取決於油壓缸爬升速度。~The cycle speed of a climbing form depends mainly on how fast the hydraulic cylinders climb.
units.practice: 以樓層循環表管理進度，標示每一工序的人員、塔吊時段與停檢點，並在開工前與爬模廠商確認牆厚變化、退縮與開口的改裝次數；哈里發塔施工中經歷超過 30 次平面配置變更，改裝要提前設計。~Manage progress with a floor-cycle chart showing crews, crane slots and hold points for each activity, and agree the number of modifications for wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings with the climbing-form supplier before starting; Burj Khalifa went through more than 30 layout changes, so modifications must be designed in advance.

units.anchor: 錨錐與爬升靴~Anchor cones and climbing shoes
units.title: 荷載由平台經錨點傳入早齡牆體~Load path from platforms through anchors into young walls
units.mechanism: 爬模的全部荷載，包括模板、多層平台、布料機、材料、人員與風力，都經由澆置時預埋的錨錐與螺桿，傳到固定在牆上的爬升靴，再進入剛硬化不久的牆體。平台通常懸挑在牆外，因此錨點同時承受垂直力與由偏心造成的水平拉壓力偶；錨點的承載力取決於混凝土當時的強度、埋置深度、邊距與周邊補強筋。PERI ACS Core 400 型錄要求牆厚至少 30 cm 並在錨點周圍加補強筋，正是為了確保錨固區不會先破壞。~All loads from the climbing system, including forms, multi-level platforms, placing booms, materials, people and wind, pass through anchor cones and bolts cast into the previous lift, into climbing shoes fixed to the wall and then into wall concrete that has only recently hardened. Platforms usually cantilever outside the wall, so anchors carry both vertical force and a horizontal tension–compression couple from the eccentricity; anchor capacity depends on concrete strength at the time, embedment depth, edge distance and local reinforcement. The PERI ACS Core 400 brochure requires walls at least 30 cm thick with extra reinforcement around the climbing anchors precisely so that the anchorage zone does not fail first.
units.model: 每個爬升單元垂直荷載 V = 60 kN、偏心 e = 1.2 m，彎矩 M = 72 kN·m；上錨點與下支承相距 2.0 m，水平力偶 H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN。單一錨點混凝土錐體拉拔基本強度 N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5（k = 10、h_ef = 150 mm）：f_c = 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，20 MPa 時約 82 kN，強度加倍但承載只增加約 √2 倍。數值為教學假設，實際值以錨具製造商的認證資料為準。~Each climbing unit carries V = 60 kN at e = 1.2 m eccentricity, M = 72 kN·m; with 2.0 m between top anchor and lower bearing, the horizontal couple is H = 72/2.0 = 36 kN. A single anchor's basic concrete-cone pull-out strength N_b = k√f_c·h_ef^1.5 with k = 10 and h_ef = 150 mm is about 58 kN at f_c = 10 MPa and 82 kN at 20 MPa: doubling strength raises capacity only by about √2. Values are teaching assumptions; real values come from the anchor maker's approvals.
units.verify: 爬模設計計算書要列出每個錨點在澆置、爬升與停放三種狀態下的拉力、剪力與所需混凝土強度，並引用錨具製造商的技術認證；現場在爬升前確認錨錐埋置深度、邊距與補強筋，並抽檢錨點周圍有無裂縫。~The climbing-form calculations must list each anchor's tension and shear in the pouring, climbing and parked states with the concrete strength required, citing the anchor manufacturer's technical approval; on site confirm cone embedment, edge distance and local reinforcement before each climb and check the concrete around anchors for cracks.
units.failure: 錨錐被振動棒碰歪或埋得太淺，或錨點落在牆體開口邊緣，混凝土錐體拉拔破壞使爬升靴脫落，平台單點失去支承而傾斜；牆體太薄或錨點區缺補強筋時，錨點周圍出現放射狀裂縫。~A cone knocked askew by a vibrator or set too shallow, or an anchor placed at the edge of an opening, can fail by concrete-cone pull-out so a climbing shoe tears off and the platform tilts on a lost support; walls too thin or anchors without local reinforcement show radial cracks around the anchors.
units.misconception: 錨點只要螺栓強度足夠，混凝土強度高低影響不大。~If the anchor bolt is strong enough, concrete strength hardly matters.
units.practice: 錨點位置要在核心筒施工圖上與開口、埋件與鋼筋衝突一併檢查，錨錐安裝列為合模前檢查項目；爬升前的混凝土強度需求應以數字寫在每層的爬升許可單上。~Check anchor positions against openings, embeds and rebar on the core shop drawings, make cone installation a pre-closing inspection item, and write the required concrete strength as a number on each storey's climbing permit.

units.anchor: 液壓油缸與爬升軌道~Hydraulic cylinders and climbing rails
units.title: 液壓爬升機構與行程控制~Hydraulic climbing mechanism and stroke control
units.mechanism: 自爬系統以固定在爬升靴上的長行程油壓缸推動爬升軌道或主架，軌道再帶動整個平台與模板上升；爬升到位後，軌道卡在新的爬升靴上，油壓缸再收回準備下一行程。PERI ACS Core 400 的長行程油壓缸每支可提供 40 t 頂升力，行程速度約 20 cm/min，一般 4 m 樓層約 20 分鐘可爬完。Doka 在哈里發塔使用 SKE100 自爬系統，並以液壓方式提升超過 5,000 m² 的大面積牆模。機構必須有防止回落的機械卡爪，以及多缸同步的控制。~Self-climbing systems use long-stroke hydraulic cylinders mounted on the climbing shoes to push the climbing rail or main frame, which lifts the whole platform and forms; once in position the rail latches into the new shoe and the cylinder retracts for the next stroke. Each long-stroke cylinder in PERI's ACS Core 400 provides 40 t of lifting force at a stroke speed of about 20 cm per minute, so a typical 4 m storey climbs in about 20 minutes. At Burj Khalifa Doka used the SKE100 self-climbing system and lifted more than 5,000 m² of large-area wall formwork hydraulically. The mechanism needs mechanical pawls that prevent fall-back and control to keep multiple cylinders in step.
units.model: 油壓缸推力 F = p·A。缸徑 125 mm 時 A = π×62.5² ≈ 12,270 mm²，油壓 32 MPa 時 F ≈ 393 kN，約 40 t。爬升 4 m、速度 0.2 m/min 需 4/0.2 = 20 min。若平台加上布料機使單元荷重升到 450 kN，需提高油壓或改用較大缸徑。數值為教學假設。~Cylinder force F = p·A. A 125 mm bore gives A = π×62.5² ≈ 12,270 mm², so at 32 MPa F ≈ 393 kN, about 40 t. Climbing 4 m at 0.2 m/min takes 4/0.2 = 20 min. If a placing boom raises a unit's load to 450 kN, higher pressure or a larger bore is needed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 出廠前對油壓缸做耐壓與負載試驗，現場每次爬升前檢查油壓表、油管、卡爪動作與限位開關；爬升中記錄各缸壓力與行程，若某缸壓力明顯高於其他缸，表示荷重分配不均或有卡阻，應立即停止檢查。~Pressure- and load-test cylinders before delivery; before every climb check gauges, hoses, pawl action and limit switches; during the climb record each cylinder's pressure and stroke, and stop to investigate immediately if one cylinder runs markedly higher than the others, which signals uneven load or binding.
units.failure: 卡爪磨損或被混凝土殘渣卡住，油壓缸收回時軌道無法鎖定而回落，造成衝擊；多缸不同步時平台扭曲，爬升軌道與爬升靴卡死，甚至使錨點承受遠超設計的偏心力。~Worn pawls or pawls jammed with concrete debris fail to lock the rail when the cylinder retracts, so the rail drops back with an impact; unsynchronised cylinders twist the platform, jam the rail in the shoe and may load the anchors with eccentric forces far beyond design.
units.misconception: 油壓缸頂升力很大，所以平台上多放材料也不會影響爬升安全。~The cylinders are so powerful that extra material on the platform does not affect climbing safety.
units.practice: 每次爬升前執行固定的檢查表（卡爪、限位、油管、錨點、平台清空），平台上只允許爬升作業人員；油壓系統的維修保養紀錄要隨設備移交，並規定卡爪與油封的更換週期。~Run a fixed checklist before every climb covering pawls, limits, hoses, anchors and a cleared platform, allow only climbing crew on the platform, keep hydraulic maintenance records with the equipment, and set replacement intervals for pawls and seals.

units.anchor: 大面積牆模與繫結螺桿~Large-area wall forms and ties
units.title: 模板側壓、澆置速度與繫結~Form pressure, pour rate and ties
units.mechanism: 爬模每次澆置高度常達 3.7 至 4.5 m（哈里發塔 3.70 m、樂天世界塔標準層 4.5 m），新鮮混凝土對模板的側壓取決於澆置速度、混凝土溫度、凝結特性與坍度。一般混凝土在澆置速度不高時，下部混凝土已開始凝結，側壓小於全液壓；但自充填混凝土或使用大量緩凝劑時，側壓接近全液壓，模板與繫結螺桿必須按液壓設計。哈里發塔的牆厚由 200 mm 變化到 1.3 m，牆越厚，單次澆置量越大、澆置時間越長，速度與側壓管理更重要。~Each climbing lift is often 3.7 to 4.5 m high (3.70 m at Burj Khalifa, 4.5 m in Lotte World Tower's typical storeys), and fresh-concrete pressure on the forms depends on pour rate, concrete temperature, setting behaviour and slump. With ordinary concrete placed at a moderate rate, the lower concrete begins to stiffen and pressure stays below fully hydrostatic; with self-consolidating concrete or heavy retarder dosages pressure approaches hydrostatic and forms and ties must be designed for it. Burj Khalifa's walls varied from 200 mm to 1.3 m thick, and thicker walls mean bigger, longer pours, making rate and pressure control more important.
units.model: ACI 347 牆模側壓 p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa。R = 2 m/h、T = 20°C、係數取 1 時 p ≈ 7.2 + 41.5 ≈ 48.7 kPa；若改用自充填混凝土須取全液壓 p = 24×3.7 ≈ 88.8 kPa。繫結螺桿間距 1.2 m×1.2 m 時，每支拉力由約 70 kN 增為約 128 kN。數值為教學假設。~ACI 347 wall-form pressure p = C_w·C_c[7.2 + 785R/(T+17.8)] kPa. With R = 2 m/h, T = 20°C and unit coefficients, p ≈ 7.2 + 41.5 ≈ 48.7 kPa; self-consolidating concrete requires full hydrostatic p = 24×3.7 ≈ 88.8 kPa. With ties at 1.2 m×1.2 m, each tie's force rises from about 70 kN to about 128 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 模板計算書須註明假設的澆置速度、混凝土溫度與配比類型，現場以澆置紀錄驗證實際速度；首次使用自充填或改變緩凝劑時，可在模板上裝設壓力感測器量測實際側壓，並觀察模板變形與繫結螺桿伸長。~The form calculations must state the assumed pour rate, concrete temperature and mix type, and pour records verify the actual rate on site; on first use of self-consolidating concrete or a new retarder dosage, fit pressure sensors to the forms to measure actual pressure and watch form deflection and tie elongation.
units.failure: 改用流動性更高的混凝土卻沿用一般混凝土的側壓設計，下部模板鼓出、繫結螺桿拉斷，混凝土從模板縫隙爆出；澆置速度在夜間因供料集中而突然加快，也會造成同樣問題。~Switching to a more fluid concrete while keeping the ordinary-concrete pressure design bulges the lower forms, snaps ties and blows concrete out of the joints; a sudden jump in pour rate at night when trucks bunch up causes the same problem.
units.misconception: 模板側壓只跟澆置高度有關，與澆置速度和配比無關。~Form pressure depends only on lift height, not on pour rate or mix.
units.practice: 在澆置許可中寫明最大澆置速度與配比類型，並由現場工程師控制車次間隔；配比或緩凝劑變更必須通知模板設計者重新檢核側壓，未經同意不得使用。~State the maximum pour rate and mix type on the pour permit and have the site engineer pace truck arrivals; notify the formwork designer of any change in mix or retarder for a pressure recheck, and do not use it without approval.

units.anchor: 平台佈置與布料機~Platform layout and placing booms
units.title: 多層平台、布料機與塔吊介面~Multi-level platforms, placing booms and crane interface
units.mechanism: 自爬系統通常有三層以上平台：最上層放置布料機與鋼筋，中間層為模板操作層，下層用於拆除錨錐與修補。樂天世界塔核心筒使用 132 組 SKE100 自爬單元，另以 12 組 SKE100 爬升 3 台混凝土布料機，讓布料機隨模板循環同步上升；8 根巨柱則使用 80 組 SKE50 plus。平台就像一座在百米高空、每幾天移動一次的臨時工廠，它的容許荷重、材料堆放區與塔吊吊料點必須事先規劃，否則最常見的錯誤就是把整捆鋼筋堆在設計荷重很小的走道上。~Self-climbing systems usually have three or more platform levels: the top carries the placing boom and rebar, the middle is the formwork operating level and the lowest is used for removing anchor cones and patching. Lotte World Tower's core used 132 SKE100 self-climbing units, with another 12 SKE100 units climbing three concrete placing booms in step with the formwork cycle, while its eight megacolumns used 80 SKE50 plus units. The platform is like a temporary factory hundreds of metres up that moves every few days; its allowable loads, stockpile zones and crane drop points must be planned beforehand, or the most common error follows: a whole bundle of rebar dumped on a walkway with a small design load.
units.model: 一捆鋼筋 3,000 kg，重 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN，若放在 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² 的平台區，平均荷重 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa，超過假設的平台容許 3.0 kPa；改以墊木分散到 10 m²，荷重降為約 2.9 kPa 才符合。數值為教學假設。~A 3,000 kg rebar bundle weighs 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 kN; set on a 2.4 m×3.0 m = 7.2 m² patch it averages 29.4/7.2 ≈ 4.1 kPa, above an assumed platform allowance of 3.0 kPa; spreading it on timbers over 10 m² brings it to about 2.9 kPa, which complies. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 平台每一層與每一區的容許荷重要標示在現場並與爬模計算書一致；吊料前由信號手確認卸料區，布料機的基座反力與風荷重要列入爬升單元荷重檢核，並由爬模設計者確認。~Post the allowable load for each platform level and zone on site, consistent with the climbing-form calculations; have the signaller confirm the drop zone before each lift, and include placing-boom base reactions and wind in the climbing-unit load check, confirmed by the climbing-form designer.
units.failure: 鋼筋與模板配件長期堆放在同一角落，使該處爬升單元超載，錨點周圍混凝土開裂；布料機在強風中旋轉或伸臂，基座傳來的力矩超過爬升單元容許值，平台局部變形。~Rebar and form accessories piled in one corner for days overload the climbing units there and crack the concrete around their anchors; slewing or extending the placing boom in strong wind sends base moments beyond the climbing unit's allowance and locally deforms the platform.
units.misconception: 爬模平台很大，所以任何位置都可以堆放材料。~Climbing-form platforms are large, so materials can be stacked anywhere on them.
units.practice: 以平面圖標示平台各區容許荷重、材料堆放區、布料機基座與人員通道，張貼在每層出入口；布料機的停放姿態與停用風速需寫入作業程序，強風時收臂並鎖定。~Mark allowable loads, stockpile zones, placing-boom bases and walkways on a platform plan posted at every access point; write the boom's parking position and wind limit into the work procedure, retracting and locking it in strong wind.

units.anchor: 爬升前停檢點~Pre-climb hold point
units.title: 爬升作業、風速管制與停檢點~Climbing operation, wind limits and hold points
units.mechanism: 爬升是爬模循環中風險最集中的步驟：模板脫離牆面、平台只由爬升機構支承、人員在高空移動。因此每次爬升前都需要一個正式停檢點，確認混凝土強度、錨點狀態、平台淨空、無人員在禁區、天候許可。高空風速比地面大得多，爬升許可必須以平台上的風速計為準，而不是地面感受。Doka 指出哈里發塔的爬模系統在停放狀態可承受超過 200 km/h 的風，但爬升作業的容許風速遠低於停放設計值，必須依製造商規定。~Climbing is the riskiest step in the cycle: forms leave the wall, the platform hangs only on the climbing mechanism and people move at height. Every climb therefore needs a formal hold point confirming concrete strength, anchor condition, a cleared platform, nobody in exclusion zones and acceptable weather. Wind at height is much stronger than at ground level, so climbing permits must rely on an anemometer on the platform rather than the feel at ground level. Doka states that the climbing systems at Burj Khalifa withstood winds above 200 km/h when parked, but the allowable wind for climbing is far lower than the parked design value and must follow the manufacturer's rules.
units.model: 以冪次律 V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α、α = 0.16 估計：400 m 高度係數 = 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80，地面 11 m/s 對應平台約 19.8 m/s。風壓比較：停放設計 200 km/h（55.6 m/s）q ≈ 1,890 Pa，假設爬升上限 20 m/s 時 q ≈ 245 Pa，相差約 7.7 倍。數值為教學假設。~Estimate with a power law V(z) = V₁₀(z/10)^α and α = 0.16: at 400 m the factor is 40^0.16 ≈ 1.80, so 11 m/s at ground corresponds to about 19.8 m/s on the platform. Comparing pressures, a 200 km/h (55.6 m/s) parked design gives q ≈ 1,890 Pa, while an assumed 20 m/s climbing limit gives q ≈ 245 Pa, about 7.7 times less. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 爬升許可單包含：混凝土強度證明、錨點與卡爪檢查、平台清空確認、禁區設置、平台風速讀值與預報，由爬模主管與工地安全主管簽名後才可啟動；爬升後確認所有爬升靴鎖定並記錄完成時間。~The climbing permit covers proof of concrete strength, anchor and pawl checks, confirmation that the platform is cleared, exclusion zones, the platform anemometer reading and forecast, and is signed by the climbing supervisor and the site safety manager before any climb starts; afterwards confirm that every shoe is locked and record the completion time.
units.failure: 依地面風況判斷可以爬升，實際平台高度的陣風已超過限值，爬升中平台受風擺動，軌道與爬升靴卡阻；未清空的材料或工具在爬升時掉落，對下方人員造成危險。~Judging from ground-level wind that climbing is fine while gusts at platform height already exceed the limit lets the platform swing during the climb and jam rails in their shoes; loose materials or tools left on the platform fall during the climb and endanger people below.
units.misconception: 地面風不大，代表高空爬模也可以安全爬升。~Light wind at ground level means the climbing form can safely climb at height.
units.practice: 爬升屬高風險作業，必須以書面許可制管理並設停檢點：爬模主管、安全主管與現場工程師各自確認其負責項目後才放行，任何人都可在發現異常時要求中止；許可單存檔作為品質紀錄。~Climbing is high-risk work managed by written permit with a hold point: the climbing supervisor, safety manager and site engineer each confirm their items before release, anyone may stop the climb on noticing an anomaly, and permits are filed as quality records.

units.anchor: 錨點區現場養護試體~Field-cured specimens at anchor level
units.title: 早齡強度驗收與爬升放行~Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release
units.mechanism: 爬升放行的核心證據是錨點所在牆體的實際強度。實驗室標準養護試體反映的是配比潛力，而不是高空平台上、夜間低溫中的實際混凝土強度；因此常用與牆體同條件養護的現場試體、溫度感測器推估或錨點區的回彈檢測。核心筒牆常使用高強度混凝土，但高強度不等於早強：大量礦物摻料降低水化熱，也會延後早期強度發展。冬季或高空寒風時，早期強度可能比預期低很多，爬升時程必須跟著調整。~The key evidence for releasing a climb is the actual strength of the wall at the anchors. Standard-cured laboratory specimens show the mix's potential, not the strength of concrete on a platform high up on a cold night, so practice uses field-cured specimens kept with the wall, temperature-based estimates or rebound checks at the anchor zone. Core walls often use high-strength concrete, but high strength is not early strength: large supplementary cementitious contents lower heat and also delay early strength gain. In winter or cold wind at height, early strength can fall far below expectation, and the climbing schedule must adjust accordingly.
units.model: 假設錨點放行強度 10 MPa、驗收規則為三個現場試體平均 ≥ 10 MPa 且單一 ≥ 9.0 MPa。20 h 時試體 11.2、10.4、9.6 MPa，平均 10.4 MPa，放行；冬季同時段為 8.1、7.6、8.4 MPa，平均約 8.0 MPa，若強度成長約 0.3 MPa/h，需再等 (10 − 8.0)/0.3 ≈ 6.6 h。數值為教學假設，不是任何專案的試驗資料。~Assume an anchor release strength of 10 MPa with the rule that three field-cured specimens average at least 10 MPa and none is below 9.0 MPa. At 20 h, results of 11.2, 10.4 and 9.6 MPa average 10.4 MPa and the climb is released; in winter the same age gives 8.1, 7.6 and 8.4 MPa, averaging about 8.0 MPa, and at a gain of about 0.3 MPa/h another (10 − 8.0)/0.3 ≈ 6.6 h is needed. Values are teaching assumptions, not test data from any project.
units.verify: 現場試體與牆體一起放在平台上養護並標示對應樓層；試驗結果在爬升許可單上填寫，並與溫度感測器推估值比對。兩者差異過大時以較保守者為準，並檢討試體養護條件是否真正代表牆體。~Keep field-cured specimens on the platform beside the wall they represent, labelled by storey; write results on the climbing permit and compare with temperature-based estimates, using the more conservative value when they differ widely and reviewing whether specimen curing truly represents the wall.
units.failure: 以標準養護試體或配比設計強度作為放行依據，忽略高空低溫，錨點區混凝土實際強度不足，爬升時錨點周圍開裂；試體放在溫暖的工務所而非平台上，同樣高估實際強度。~Releasing climbs on standard-cured results or mix-design strength while ignoring cold at height leaves anchor-zone concrete too weak, and it cracks around the anchors during the climb; storing specimens in a warm site office instead of on the platform overestimates real strength in the same way.
units.misconception: 核心筒用的是高強度混凝土，所以一天後一定已經足夠讓錨點承載。~Core walls use high-strength concrete, so after one day the anchors can certainly carry load.
units.practice: 品質計畫中規定放行強度、試體數量、養護位置與試驗時間，並把冬季的延長等待寫入循環表；任何不符合時都不得以主管口頭同意代替，須由結構或臨時工程設計者書面處理。~Set the release strength, number of specimens, curing location and test age in the quality plan and build longer winter waits into the cycle chart; never replace a nonconformance with a supervisor's verbal approval, but have the structural or temporary-works designer resolve it in writing.

units.anchor: 平台傾斜與油壓監測~Platform tilt and hydraulic monitoring
units.title: 爬升同步、平台傾斜與荷重監測~Climbing synchronisation, platform tilt and load monitoring
units.mechanism: 一個核心筒可能同時有上百組爬升單元，例如哈里發塔共有 226 組自爬單元，整體平台由許多單元以剛接或鉸接連在一起。爬升時若各單元行程不同步，平台會產生傾斜與扭轉，連接處產生附加內力，落後的單元可能被拖著走或承擔額外荷重。現代系統以中央控制同時讀取各缸壓力、行程與平台傾斜，設定警戒值與自動停止值；人員仍需在爬升中目視確認軌道與爬升靴的位置。~A core may have over a hundred climbing units working together; Burj Khalifa had 226 self-climbing units in total, with the platforms linked by rigid or pinned connections. If units stroke unevenly during a climb, the platform tilts and twists, the connections pick up extra forces, and a lagging unit may be dragged along or carry extra load. Modern systems read each cylinder's pressure, stroke and platform tilt centrally, with alert and automatic stop values; people still need to watch rails and shoes during the climb.
units.model: 爬升 4 m、兩單元速度差 0.5% 時，終點高差 = 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm；單元間距 6 m，平台斜率 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300。若規定高差警戒值 10 mm，同步控制必須在爬升到約 2 m 前修正。數值為教學假設。~Climbing 4 m with a 0.5% speed difference between two units leaves a level difference of 4,000×0.005 = 20 mm; at 6 m unit spacing the platform slope is 20/6,000 ≈ 1:300. With a 10 mm alert value, synchronisation must correct the difference before about 2 m of travel. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 爬升中以控制系統記錄每缸壓力與行程曲線，並於平台四角設傾斜計；爬升完成後以水準儀抽測平台水平，與控制系統讀值比對。壓力異常偏高的單元要檢查是否卡阻或平台荷重集中。~Log each cylinder's pressure and stroke during the climb and fit inclinometers at platform corners; after the climb spot-check platform level with an optical level against the control readings, and inspect any unit with abnormally high pressure for binding or concentrated platform load.
units.failure: 控制系統的行程感測器故障而未發現，單一單元持續落後，平台連接處螺栓剪斷或平台撕開；人員只看控制面板而不巡視，未發現某個爬升靴未完全鎖定，下一次澆置時錨點受力異常。~A failed stroke sensor goes unnoticed while one unit keeps lagging, shearing connection bolts or tearing the platform apart; staff who watch only the control panel without walking the platform miss a shoe that has not fully latched, and its anchor is loaded abnormally at the next pour.
units.misconception: 只要控制面板沒有警報，平台就一定是水平且所有單元都已鎖定。~If the control panel shows no alarm, the platform must be level and every unit locked.
units.practice: 爬升作業至少配置一位專責巡視員沿平台確認爬升靴與軌道狀態，並與控制員以無線電保持聯絡；控制系統的感測器每月校正，紀錄保存於設備檔案。~Assign at least one patrol person to walk the platform during each climb checking shoes and rails, in radio contact with the operator; calibrate control sensors monthly and keep the records in the equipment file.

units.anchor: 錨錐孔與修補~Anchor-cone holes and patching
units.title: 錨錐孔封堵、耐久與防火~Plugging cone holes for durability and fire
units.mechanism: 每次爬升都在牆上留下錨錐孔與螺桿孔，拆除錨錐後必須以專用塞頭或修補砂漿封堵。這些孔洞若未妥善處理，會成為水、氯離子與二氧化碳進入的捷徑，也可能削弱防火時的保護層。高層核心筒多在電梯井與樓梯間，孔洞位置可能在日後難以到達的位置，所以應在下層平台趁平台經過時立即處理。哈里發塔約有 2,500 次爬升步驟，留下的孔洞數量以千計，必須以系統化方式追蹤。~Each climb leaves anchor-cone and bolt holes in the wall, which must be plugged with purpose-made plugs or repair mortar after the cones are removed. Poorly treated holes become short paths for water, chlorides and carbon dioxide and can weaken the cover that protects reinforcement in fire. High-rise cores enclose elevator shafts and stairs, where holes may later be hard to reach, so they should be treated from the lowest platform while it passes. Burj Khalifa involved about 2,500 climbing steps, leaving holes in the thousands that had to be tracked systematically.
units.model: 若約 2,500 次爬升步驟每次留下 2 個錨孔，總數約 5,000 個；以 5% 抽查率做附著與密實度檢查，需檢查約 250 個。若抽查不合格率超過 2%（即 5 個以上），則擴大檢查該批次所有孔洞。數值中的爬升步驟數取自公開資料，其餘為教學假設。~If each of about 2,500 climbing steps leaves two anchor holes, there are about 5,000 holes; a 5% sample for bond and compaction checks means about 250 inspections. If more than 2% of the sample (five or more) fails, all holes in that batch are inspected. The climbing-step count is from public information; the rest are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在下層平台以檢查表逐孔記錄封堵日期、材料批號與施作者，以敲擊或拉拔試驗抽查附著；電梯井內的孔洞要在電梯導軌安裝前完成檢查並拍照存證。~Record each hole's plugging date, material batch and installer on a checklist from the lowest platform, sample bond by tapping or pull-off tests, and inspect and photograph holes inside elevator shafts before rails are installed.
units.failure: 封堵塞頭僅以乾縮大的砂漿塞填，日後脫落或出現環狀裂縫，雨水沿孔洞滲入鋼筋區；外牆孔洞未封堵，多年後出現鏽水痕，修補需搭設高空吊籠，費用遠高於當初施作。~Plugs set in high-shrinkage mortar later fall out or ring-crack, letting rain reach the reinforcement; unplugged holes on exterior walls show rust stains years later, and repairs need high-level cradles at far greater cost than doing it right at the time.
units.misconception: 錨錐孔很小，封不封堵對結構與耐久沒有影響。~Anchor-cone holes are small, so plugging them has no effect on structure or durability.
units.practice: 孔洞封堵材料與方法要與防火、防水需求一起在規範中指定，並列為下層平台的固定工序；孔洞封堵完成率應隨樓層循環一起統計，未完成者不得讓平台離開該高程太遠。~Specify plugging materials and methods together with fire and waterproofing requirements, make plugging a fixed task on the lowest platform, track completion with the floor cycle and do not let the platform move far beyond a level with unfinished holes.

units.anchor: 頂部拆除與設備紀錄~Top-out dismantling and equipment records
units.title: 改裝紀錄、頂部拆除與工程交接~Modification records, top-out dismantling and handover
units.mechanism: 爬模在施工期間會因牆厚變化、退縮、開口與巨柱轉換而多次改裝，每次改裝都改變了平台荷重與錨點配置，因此改裝圖與計算必須和原設計同樣受控。到達頂部後，平台需在高空分段拆除並以塔吊吊下，這時塔吊能力、吊點與拆除順序決定了安全；拆除過程中剩餘平台的穩定性也要計算。交接時，結構業主需要的是牆體品質紀錄（錨孔、修補、強度、垂直度），而設備供應商需要的是設備使用與損耗紀錄。~During construction a climbing form is modified many times for changes in wall thickness, setbacks, openings and megacolumn transitions, and each modification changes platform loads and anchor layout, so modification drawings and calculations need the same control as the original design. At the top the platforms must be dismantled in sections at height and lowered by crane, where crane capacity, pick points and dismantling sequence decide safety, and the stability of the remaining platform during dismantling must also be calculated. At handover the structural owner needs wall quality records, such as anchor holes, repairs, strength and verticality, while the equipment supplier needs records of use and wear.
units.model: 以哈里發塔的 226 組單元為規模參考，若每組拆成約 5 t 的吊件、塔吊每小時可完成 4 次吊卸，約需 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h 塔吊時間，約 7 個 8 小時工作天；若高空風速每天只允許一半時段作業，就要約 14 天。數值為教學假設。~Taking Burj Khalifa's 226 units as the scale, if each unit is dismantled into lifts of about 5 t and the crane manages four lifts per hour, about 226/4 ≈ 56.5 h of crane time are needed, about seven 8-hour days; if wind at height allows work only half the time, about 14 days. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每次改裝都需有版本控制的圖面與計算，由爬模設計者簽認並在現場張貼生效版本；拆除計畫須包含拆除順序、剩餘平台穩定計算、吊件重量清單與禁區，並設停檢點由臨時工程設計者確認。~Every modification needs version-controlled drawings and calculations signed by the climbing-form designer, with the current version posted on site; the dismantling plan must include sequence, stability calculations for the remaining platform, a list of lift weights and exclusion zones, with a hold point confirmed by the temporary-works designer.
units.failure: 現場自行改裝平台而未通知設計者，原本的錨點配置無法承受新增懸挑，平台在下一次爬升時變形；拆除時先拆掉提供穩定的斜撐，剩餘平台在風中失穩，構件墜落。~Modifying a platform on site without telling the designer leaves the original anchor layout unable to carry a new cantilever, and the platform deforms at the next climb; removing stabilising braces first during dismantling lets the remaining platform become unstable in wind and pieces fall.
units.misconception: 爬模到頂後拆除只是組裝的反向步驟，不需要另做計算。~Dismantling at the top is just assembly in reverse and needs no separate calculation.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含每層爬升許可與強度紀錄、錨孔封堵紀錄、改裝版本清單、垂直度量測與修補位置圖；拆除作業列為高風險作業，須由臨時工程設計者、吊裝工程師與安全主管共同核准。~Handover should include each storey's climbing permits and strength records, anchor-hole plugging records, the list of modification versions, verticality surveys and repair maps; dismantling is high-risk work requiring joint approval by the temporary-works designer, lifting engineer and safety manager.

example: 規劃練習：一座 180 層次澆置、每層 3.7 m 的核心筒採用自動爬模。標準循環 72 h，總計 180×3 = 540 天。每個爬升單元垂直荷載 60 kN、偏心 1.2 m，錨點水平力偶 36 kN；錨點拉拔基本強度在 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，因此放行強度訂為 10 MPa。油壓缸缸徑 125 mm、油壓 32 MPa，推力約 393 kN，爬升 3.7 m、速度 0.2 m/min 約 18.5 min。牆模側壓以 R = 2 m/h、20°C 計約 48.7 kPa，繫結 1.2 m 間距時每支約 70 kN。冬季時早齡強度在 20 h 只有約 8.0 MPa，若每層需再等 6.6 h，循環變為約 78.6 h，180 層多出約 180×6.6/24 ≈ 50 天；若改用自充填混凝土，側壓升為約 88.8 kPa，繫結力增為約 128 kN，模板與繫結必須重新設計。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的施工計畫。~Planning exercise: a core cast in 180 lifts of 3.7 m uses automatic climbing forms. The standard cycle is 72 h, so 180×3 = 540 days in total. Each climbing unit carries 60 kN at 1.2 m eccentricity, giving a 36 kN anchor couple; the basic anchor pull-out strength at 10 MPa is about 58 kN, so the release strength is set at 10 MPa. A 125 mm cylinder at 32 MPa gives about 393 kN and climbs 3.7 m at 0.2 m/min in about 18.5 min. Wall-form pressure at R = 2 m/h and 20°C is about 48.7 kPa, about 70 kN per tie at 1.2 m spacing. In winter, early strength at 20 h is only about 8.0 MPa; waiting another 6.6 h each storey stretches the cycle to about 78.6 h and adds about 180×6.6/24 ≈ 50 days over 180 lifts. Switching to self-consolidating concrete raises pressure to about 88.8 kPa and tie force to about 128 kN, so forms and ties must be redesigned. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building's construction plan.
history: 自爬模板由傳統的吊升跳模發展而來，把模板、平台與油壓頂升機構整合成不依賴塔吊的系統。PERI 的 ACS 自爬系統型錄把 1994 年的吉隆坡雙子星塔列為早期參考案例；2004 年起興建、2010 年完工的哈里發塔，由 Doka 以 SKE100 自爬系統配合 Top 50 大面積牆模，以 3 天樓層循環完成核心筒與翼牆，並首次使用 Xclimb 60 自爬防護屏。2012 年樂天世界塔核心筒以 132 組 SKE100 爬升，另以自爬單元同步提升混凝土布料機。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Self-climbing formwork evolved from crane-lifted jump forms by integrating forms, platforms and hydraulic lifting into a system that does not depend on the tower crane. PERI's ACS self-climbing literature lists the Petronas Towers of 1994 among its early references; at Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010, Doka used the SKE100 self-climbing system with Top 50 large-area wall forms to build the core and wing walls on a three-day floor cycle and used the Xclimb 60 self-climbing protection screen for the first time. In 2012 Lotte World Tower's core climbed on 132 SKE100 units, with further self-climbing units lifting the concrete placing booms in step. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 哈里發塔使用 226 組自爬單元，約 2,500 次爬升步驟~Burj Khalifa used 226 self-climbing units and about 2,500 climbing steps
哈里發塔核心筒標準循環每層 3 天，共 180 次澆置、每次 3.70 m 高~Burj Khalifa's core ran a standard 3-day floor cycle over 180 pours of 3.70 m each
哈里發塔牆厚由 200 mm 到 1.3 m，牆模約 1.2 km，Top 50 大面積模板逾 5,000 m²~Burj Khalifa's walls ranged from 200 mm to 1.3 m thick, with about 1.2 km of wall forms and over 5,000 m² of Top 50 large-area formwork
哈里發塔爬模系統停放狀態可承受超過 200 km/h 的風~Burj Khalifa's climbing systems were designed to withstand winds above 200 km/h when parked
樂天世界塔核心筒用 132 組 SKE100，另 12 組提升 3 台布料機，8 根巨柱用 80 組 SKE50 plus~Lotte World Tower's core used 132 SKE100 units, 12 more lifted 3 placing booms, and its 8 megacolumns used 80 SKE50 plus units
樂天世界塔高 555 m、123 層，核心筒標準澆置高度 4.5 m~Lotte World Tower is 555 m tall with 123 storeys, and its typical core lifts were 4.5 m
PERI ACS Core 400 長行程油壓缸每支 40 t、行程速度約 20 cm/min，4 m 樓層約 20 分鐘爬完~PERI ACS Core 400 long-stroke cylinders lift 40 t each at about 20 cm per minute, climbing a 4 m storey in about 20 minutes
PERI ACS Core 400 建議用於 30 層以上建築，最快每週 2 層，牆厚至少 30 cm~PERI ACS Core 400 is recommended for 30 storeys or more, up to 2 floors per week, with walls at least 30 cm thick

timeline.event: 吉隆坡雙子星塔被列為 PERI 自爬系統的早期參考案例~The Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur are listed as an early reference for PERI's self-climbing system
哈里發塔以 SKE100 自爬系統與 3 天樓層循環興建核心筒，2010 年完工~Burj Khalifa's core is built with SKE100 self-climbing units on a three-day cycle, completed in 2010
樂天世界塔核心筒以 132 組 SKE100 爬升至約 140 m，布料機同步自爬~Lotte World Tower's core climbs on 132 SKE100 units to about 140 m, with placing booms self-climbing in step
紐約 555 Tenth Avenue 等高層案例使用 PERI ACS 自爬系統~High-rises such as 555 Tenth Avenue in New York use the PERI ACS self-climbing system
